profile.bio:
I am a third-year Ph.D. student in computer science at the Lands Group, State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology of Nanjing University. I hope to do some meaningful things that build a learning and research path from sensing, recognition, and cognition to embodied intelligence and AI agents.

profile.copyBio: Guodong Liu (Eric Liu) is a third-year Ph.D. student in computer science at the State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University. His research builds a path from sensing, recognition and cognition to embodied intelligence and AI agents, spanning mobile sensing, speech reconstruction, mmWave radar, trustworthy voice, AI for medicine and multimodal intelligence.

interests.item: Embodied Intelligence (RL, XLA/VLA/WM, Robot), and Physical AI;
Edge/Sensing LM (Low-Bit LM, Model Compression), and Agents;
Machine Learning, Representation Learning, Generative Model (Diffusion / Flow Matching / AR);
Multi-modal Intelligence (Vision, Speech/Ultrasound/Acoustics, mmWave, Accelerometer, WiFi, and so on), and HCI.
